query: What percentage of active listings in the west region have been on the market for more than 45 days?
reference_code: import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_csv('listings.csv'); west=df[(df['region']=='west')&(df['status']=='active')]; pct=round(len(west[west['days_on_market']>45])/len(west)*100,1); print(pct)

query: Which property type has the highest average days on market for active listings?
reference_code: import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_csv('listings.csv'); active=df[df['status']=='active']; avg=active.groupby('property_type')['days_on_market'].mean(); print(avg.idxmax())
reference_label: house (51.9 days avg vs apartment: 40.3, studio: 50.0)

query: How many active listings does each region have, ranked from most to least?
reference_code: import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_csv('listings.csv'); counts=df[df['status']=='active'].groupby('region').size().sort_values(ascending=False); print(counts.to_string())
